---
title: "Measured mixed-chloride water properties"
---

The [mixed-chloride study](2026-mixed-chloride-water-activity/notebook.qmd)
compares complete Held and provisional Figiel declarations with independent
NaCl–MgCl₂ and NaCl–CaCl₂ water-property observations.
Neither declaration meets the frozen mixture limits, and the binary-fit
improvement fails the all-bucket transfer test.
The notebook retains the residuals, source sensitivity cases and composition
limit for applying ternary evidence to the MS-2 brine.

The native general-composition water property has separate independent
numerical support in [Engine review 558](https://github.com/tannerpolley/ePC-SAFT/issues/558).
That support does not qualify either declaration against measurements.
The [correlated measurement-error study](2026-correlated-measurement-errors/notebook.qmd)
verifies native fitting with a known joint output/input measurement covariance
on synthetic cases; it makes no physical validation claim.

The [chloride brine refit](2026-chloride-brine-refit/notebook.qmd) trains
Na⁺, Mg²⁺ and Ca²⁺ on binary and mixture osmotic data and tests both forms
against the same held-out measurements. Neither meets the frozen rule; the
owner qualified the Figiel-form refit for NaCl–MgCl₂–CaCl₂ brines with its one
failing source-rounding realization stated as the limit, and the Held form
stays unqualified.

The [audit timing campaign](2026-audit-timing-campaign/notebook.qmd) measures the four
audits' speed questions at current main against FeOs and Clapeyron and records, per audit
question, whether its finding still holds, was fixed by a named issue, or is new. Every
block ran on a loaded shared host, so its times are shared-host measurements.

The [lithium chloride refit](2026-lithium-chloride-refit/notebook.qmd) repairs
the trace-LiCl bound and Lithium's activity targets on the qualified chloride
basis. The separately declared joint Li/Na/Mg fit preserves the LiCl binary
guard but still fails Li–Mg mixtures, the full old chloride rule and divalent
transfer preservation. No new parameter packet is created; the diagnosis
returns the question to a new physics design outside this campaign.

The broader [analysis catalogue](README.md) lists the repository's other
studies; this selected Quarto publication contains the linked studies and
this overview.

The [higher-order derivative comparisons](2026-solver-capability-matrix/notebook.qmd)
retain native action/reference operands and allowances for the neutral ternary,
aqueous electrolyte and analytic manufactured isomerization. The selected
second- and third-order comparisons satisfy the existing criteria on the named
release. This is numerical verification on declared smooth branches; independent
delivered review and investigator promotion remain pending.

The [Sr and Ba binary calibrations](2026-strontium-barium-chloride-basis/notebook.qmd)
identify their sole ion–water coefficients under the frozen numerical rule,
then fail evaluated-binary accuracy in both concentration buckets. These are
calibration results, with no reserved measurement scoring or parameter adoption.

The effective sulfate trial in the [same notebook](2026-strontium-barium-chloride-basis/notebook.qmd)
is now admitted with chloride-basis mixing retained, then fails the prescribed
local-resolution screen at every declared point. Complete exact columns and
nonempty native state/reference diagnostics support this numerical result.
Fitting and accuracy scoring were not reached; the fixed transfer hypothesis
returns to the owner before either reserved sulfate study or a parameter packet.

The [named-release computational cost study](2026-release-computational-cost/notebook.qmd)
compares value-matched serial operations against FeOs and Clapeyron on the owner-defined quiet host,
and reports marginal first-order actions separately from equilibrium solves.
Independent delivered review and owner promotion remain outstanding.
